keyEvents.text: Goal! Udinese 0, Roma 1. Bryan Cristante (Roma) header from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Wesley with a cross.
Lennon Miller (Udinese) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Udinese 0, Roma 2. Rodrigo Mora (Roma) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Bryan Cristante.
Goal! Udinese 0, Roma 3. Donyell Malen (Roma) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Matías Soulé.
Goal! Udinese 0, Roma 4. Evan Ndicka (Roma) header from the centre of the box to the high centre of the goal. Assisted by Matías Soulé with a cross following a corner.
First Half ends, Udinese 0, Roma 4.
Goal! Udinese 1, Roma 4. Nicolò Zaniolo (Udinese) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner.
Substitution, Udinese. Unai Gómez replaces Keinan Davis.
Substitution, Udinese. Giorgi Chakvetadze replaces Jurgen Ekkelenkamp.
Substitution, Roma. Niccolò Pisilli replaces Rodrigo Mora.
Substitution, Roma. Santiago Castro replaces Donyell Malen.
Bryan Cristante (Roma) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay in match because of an injury Jesper Karlström (Udinese).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Udinese. Jakub Piotrowski replaces Nicolò Zaniolo.
Goal! Udinese 2, Roma 4. Matteo Palma (Udinese) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Hassane Kamara following a corner.
Substitution, Roma. Devyne Rensch replaces Wesley.
Substitution, Roma. Gianluca Mancini replaces Matías Soulé.
Substitution, Udinese. Lazar Jovanovic replaces Jesper Karlström.
Substitution, Udinese. Juan Arizala replaces Hassane Kamara.
Substitution, Roma. Konstantinos Koulierakis replaces Mario Hermoso.
Goal! Udinese 2, Roma 5. Daniele Ghilardi (Roma) right footed shot from the right side of the box to the high centre of the goal. Assisted by Santiago Castro.
Second Half ends, Udinese 2, Roma 5.
